Robro33 said:
You might need to use user.performCollapse() if the poison killed them, but iirc custom regenerate effects handle that
Click to expand...
It's there, but I'm not sure it works correctly. It uses isDead() for the check, which is not immediately true - the death state doesn't get applied until the battler's hp is 0 and it gets refreshed.
That's why in the middle of notetags checking the hp directly is more reliable.
We'll see if the suggestion above fixes it.

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
Um...read through your Attack action sequence.
In the setup action, it sets the targets to immortal (which is unnecessary since you're only doing one hit), and it never turns it off.
So if you ever attack anything, it's getting stuck with an immortal state on it.
Delete that command.

posts.author: Robro33
posts.body: it is unnecessary, but the default finish action turns off immortality on the targets (and default setup also turns it on regardless. so an attack without any AS tags would do the same things in terms of immortality). the enemy did remain where they were if they had to move for the skill, but when they took the toxic damage they still died and disappeared for me
